description: An interface library for RL post training with environments.
vibe: Monorepo pragmatist who knows exactly which tests skip and why.
highlights: Explicitly documents that ~129 tests skip without optional env deps — expected, not a failure.
Calls out pre-existing lint failures (usort on two test files) so agents don't chase ghosts.
Clarifies that `openenv serve` is a stub and the real path is running the server module directly.
Notes Docker is not required for core dev and is not installed by the update script.
Delegates standard build/test/lint commands to CLAUDE.md rather than duplicating them.
assessment: This file demonstrates mature operational taste: it pre-empts the most common agent failure modes — chasing pre-existing lint errors, misreading skipped tests as regressions, and assuming Docker or a backend is needed. By separating 'what's expected' from 'what's broken,' it lets an agent distinguish signal from noise without trial and error. The delegation to CLAUDE.md keeps a single source of truth for commands while layering cloud-specific context cleanly.
